values.binNote: LissandraQ#TotalDamage = Damage + 0.75xap carries the 0.75 AP ratio, but the sheet flags that this calculation names a missing data value 'Damage' rather than resolving to LissandraQ.damage; the flat base is taken from LissandraQ.damage directly since it matches the wiki's 80/115/150/185/220.
LissandraQ.slowPercentage stores the slow as a negative multiplier (-0.2 to -0.36); the wiki states the magnitude as a positive percentage (20 to 36%), same numbers with opposite sign convention.

mechanics.claim: Ice Shard deals damage to all enemies its missile passes through, not just the first target.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies it passes through

mechanics.claim: Hitting an enemy causes the missile to shatter, becoming wider and extending its maximum range, allowing it to hit additional targets further along the path.
mechanics.quote: If ''Ice Shard'' hits an enemy, it will shatter, increasing its width and maximum range.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks the damage and slow, but does not prevent the missile from shattering (so it can still hit others).
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage and the slow but will not stop the projectile from shattering.
